SRC-240:R001.text: Section 1 LIVE ADMISSION: establish the canonical SAIPEN root, HEAD, dirty tree, protocol version, current work owner, STOP/NO_GO state and permitted mutation scope; check the Wintage project admission separately before any integration check that could mutate it; a valid handoff does not itself authorize execution; no hand alteration of canonical ledgers or durable epoch carriers

SRC-240:R002.text: Section 2 CONFIRMED DEFECT BOUNDARY: recheck the reported locations in release.py (plan_release, crew release context, _plan_crew_release, _apply_no_publish_locked) and crew.py (epoch validation, crew_release_context, _release_current, ReleaseEvidence) against the live installed code before editing; verify the live epoch carrier

SRC-240:R003.text: Section 3 CONTRACT AND FEASIBILITY SPIKE: decide whether terminal crew closure can use the existing epoch identity plus independently derived deferred scope without inventing a ticket; prove the minimal legal path on a disposable fixture; published release, local no-publish completion and refused or incomplete convergence must never be interchangeable; document schema and recovery compatibility before changing stored evidence

SRC-240:R004.text: Section 4 VERSIONLESS NO-PUBLISH: an authorized local no-publish completion needs no VERSION file; strict version validation stays for real publication; never synthesize version 0, a fake release tag or a publication claim; no change to Wintage package.json, userscript versions, CHANGELOG, HEAD or source fingerprint as a workaround

SRC-240:R005.text: Section 5 TICKETLESS CREW EPOCH: resolve the producer/consumer contradiction (a valid epoch may have no ticket_id, terminal planning required one); own the terminal closure by canonical epoch identity and verified deferred-scope receipts; never invent or borrow a ticket or mutate a committed carrier; refuse clearly on empty deferred scope and on ambiguous ownership; protect multi-ticket deferred scope, lineage, exact file hashes, review bindings and epoch identity

SRC-240:R006.text: Section 6 POST-SHIP TRUTH: the release verdict and its immutable evidence identify the actual terminal outcome, never inferred from historical STATE.mode; the validator distinguishes no-publish with a valid receipt, real publish with commit/tag/remote evidence, missing or forged receipt, stale source identity, wrong epoch, incomplete convergence; read-only and current-session authority stay enforced; an authorized no-publish closure performs zero Git mutations and zero remote operations; real publication keeps every existing gate; SC-11 is not skipped globally
